signature.name: VTask.liftOn
signature.type: {α : Type u} -> {β : α → Type v} -> {γ : Type u_1} -> (s : Finmap β) -> (f : AList β → γ) -> (H : ∀ (a b : AList β), a.entries.Perm b.entries → f a = f b) -> γ

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: The function is total and well-defined for all inputs satisfying the permutation-invariance hypothesis; there are no junk-value conventions or special edge treatments.

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} {β : α → Type*} {γ : Type*} (s : Finmap β) (c : γ) (H : ∀ (a b : AList β), a.entries.Perm b.entries → c = c), VTask.liftOn s (fun _ => c) H = c

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} {β : α → Type*} (s : AList β) (H : ∀ (a b : AList β), a.entries.Perm b.entries → a = b → True), True

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} {β : α → Type*} {γ : Type*} (s₁ s₂ : Finmap β) (f : AList β → γ) (H : ∀ (a b : AList β), a.entries.Perm b.entries → f a = f b), s₁ = s₂ → VTask.liftOn s₁ f H = VTask.liftOn s₂ f H

facts.statement: ¬ (∀ (α : Type) (β : α → Type) (γ : Type) (s : Finmap β) (f g : AList β → γ) (Hf : ∀ a b : AList β, a.entries.Perm b.entries → f a = f b) (Hg : ∀ a b : AList β, a.entries.Perm b.entries → g a = g b), VTask.liftOn s f Hf = VTask.liftOn s g Hg)
